finding.issue: Absolute exclusion of other pad/clock owners may include required stock boot initialization or unused exported APIs.
finding.clarification: Exclude competing/reachable writers during or after ADC admission; permit only the audited stock boot setup completed beforehand. Mere loader exports/device descriptors are not execution. Exact enabled-image plus installed-loader call/worker analysis and live guards remain mandatory.

authority: D051 engineering choice plus current user-reported bare UNO Q test authorization can support a newly explicit observation-only D078 deployment exception. D052 by itself names P0; adoption must explicitly state new scope rather than claiming old D078 already allowed it. SC-AJ, R8 pin/wiring rights, all physical gates and motor restrictions remain unchanged.
native_review: One passive Native embeds one Reader; beginWithButtons, rank10 readButtons only; no A0 conversion.
A0/PA4 and A1/PA5 fixed admission checked; PA4 rewrite same checked analog mode, PA5 not remuxed.
ADC1 clock gate may remain enabled after failed pristine admission; no fabricated no-side-effect or shutdown claim.
Existing clock/supply/stock ADC1/ADC4/DAC/IRQ/reset-only guards retained; whole-image concurrency exclusion remains separately necessary.
COMPLETE leaves ADC enabled/idle; no stop API. Frozen-clock early polling can remain RUNNING and must be reported, not repaired.
minimality: One named wrapper and literal stage reuse of four exact D112 files is narrower than a fork/shared-source framework; collision and ancestry checks plus unchanged ordinary UI behavior are required.
deferred_requirements: Re-derive all ABI and relocated symbol offsets from enabled image; D112 values are verified baseline only.
Freeze public decoder schema before tests, including terminal semantic equality/padding treatment, honest partial FAULT and nonterminal/torn samples.
Pin full deployed loader/sketch and exact read plan/count/byte/command/time ceilings before any RAM read; D104 and P0 helpers have different limits, so name the selected wrapper explicitly.
Exact source/ELF/package/loader/startup/native ownership/guard/readout review and identified single run remain required; no present upload approval.
limits: Read-only local draft/source/cached-artifact preflight, reused same-model reviewer. No tests, board/socket, MCU attach/read/write/reset, source/test/config or ledger changes.
